dialogues.speaker: Rostislav
dialogues.text: Oof... I need to sit a while.

dialogues.speaker: Rostislav
dialogues.text: Ah, a young one. No need, no need — I just need a quiet moment to rest.

dialogues.speaker: Rostislav
dialogues.text: I know this path too well. I walk it every day... I'll be back up and moving in a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Rostislav
dialogues.text: Ahaha, thank you. I'm just a bit sturdier than most people my age.

dialogues.speaker: Rostislav
dialogues.text: A lot of young folks get winded climbing this path, but I go up and down five or six times a day without breaking a sweat. Ever seen the "Health Guardian" section?

dialogues.speaker: Rostislav
dialogues.text: It says, "After 40, walking an extra hour a day adds 100 minutes to your lifespan..."

dialogues.speaker: Rostislav
dialogues.text: Truly wise words... Hey, how about joining me for a walk every day from now on, young friend?

dialogues.speaker: Rostislav
dialogues.text: No worries, I was just about to sit down and rest anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I might not have that much time...

dialogues.speaker: Rostislav
dialogues.text: Ah, you'll understand later. Some time can be saved, but some time absolutely shouldn't be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: My daily exercise is already enough.

dialogues.speaker: Rostislav
dialogues.text: What a pity. But allow this old man one last word of advice: walking is the best exercise. And don't forget to check the "Health Guardian" section...
